_note: Lore snippets a prompt may cite by id (request context.canon). Placeholder canon for the foundation; the design repo owns the lore, and new ids land here with the content that needs them. An unknown id makes the request a bad_request.

lore.archive.two-clocks: The ship keeps two clocks. Ship time is the one the crew lives by; home time runs faster, and the nearer the ship flies to the speed of light, the wider the gap grows.
lore.archive.sol: Sol is the star the voyage left behind. The light the ship sees from it is always older than the last message home.
